grains.RAW.POLICY_BOOKS: one row per policy book (market x line of business)
grains.RAW.BOOK_DAILY: one row per policy book per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.CLAIM_DOCUMENTS: one row per policy book (supporting-document snapshot)
grains.ML.FRAUD_RISK_SCORES: one row per policy book (latest day)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.fraud_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(confirmed fraudulent claim in next 7 days) per policy book, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day portfolio-wide claims FORECAST; document mismatch ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.CLAIMS_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic claims-investigation SOPs (one per line of business and fraud indicator)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.CLAIMS_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.CLAIMS_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, policy book, fraud-indicator and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (policy books, daily claims, confirmed fraud by book, fraudulent-claim risk, claim events loaded) over an existing Snowflake data source
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: S3 PutObject of FNOL claim batches -> S3 (claims/) -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_CLAIMS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_CLAIM_ALERT logs new REFER events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
